milestones.title: Performance Foundation
milestones.description: Cache text and raster output to eliminate per-frame recomputation

milestones.title: Image Interaction

stories.title: Cache output_lines() at OutputWidget level
stories.completedNote: Added _cached_output_lines + _cached_output_lines_id to OutputWidget. cached_output_lines() caches by objectid(cell.output). Render uses cached version. 18 new tests, 3473 total.
stories.description: output_lines() calls sprint(show, MIME"text/plain"(), result) every frame. Cache the result in OutputWidget, invalidating on objectid(cell.output) change. Add _cached_output_lines and _cached_output_lines_id fields.
acceptanceCriteria: New tests verify cache hit/miss behavior

stories.title: Cache encoded raster bytes at OutputWidget level
stories.completedNote: Added _cached_encoded_data/rect/image_hash/protocol to OutputWidget. _render_image_cached_raster!() bypasses encode on cache hit, using render_graphics!() directly. 16 new tests, 3489 total.
stories.description: Tachikoma re-encodes sixel/kitty data every frame (~5-20ms for sixel). Cache the encoded bytes at the OutputWidget level. Store _cached_encoded_data and _cached_encoded_rect. Invalidate when image_data objectid changes or rect dimensions change. Use Tachikoma.render_graphics!() to emit pre-encoded data directly to Frame.
acceptanceCriteria: Encoded bytes cached and reused across frames with same image+rect
Cache invalidated on image_data change or rect resize
Braille fallback still works (gfx_none path unchanged)

stories.title: Aspect-aware image sizing
stories.completedNote: Added decode_png_dimensions() header parser, image_output_height() with aspect ratio formula. Height clamped [4,30]. 26 new tests, 3515 total.
stories.description: Replace fixed _IMAGE_OUTPUT_HEIGHT=12 with aspect ratio computation. Read PNG IHDR dimensions from decode_png (or a lightweight header-only parser). Compute terminal rows = (img_height / img_width) * available_width / cell_pixel_ratio. Clamp to [4, 30] rows. Cache dimensions alongside pixel cache.
acceptanceCriteria: Image height computed from aspect ratio, not fixed 12
Tall images get more rows, wide images get fewer
decode_png_dimensions() utility function for header-only parse
All existing tests pass (output_height test updated)

stories.title: Terminal resize cache invalidation
stories.completedNote: Added _last_viewport_size to NotebookView, flush_image_caches!() and detect_viewport_resize!(). Wired into render(). 12 new tests, 3527 total.
stories.description: When terminal resizes, cached encoded raster bytes and PixelImage become stale (wrong dimensions). Detect resize by comparing current rect to _cached_encoded_rect. Already handled by rect comparison in 9002, but add explicit _last_viewport_size to NotebookView that triggers full image cache flush on change.
acceptanceCriteria: Image caches flushed on terminal resize
Non-image caches (text output) preserved across resize

stories.title: JPEG image support
stories.completedNote: Added jpeg_decoder.jl with decode_jpeg() (baseline SOF0) and decode_jpeg_dimensions(). classify_output detects :image_jpeg. Capture/render pipeline supports JPEG alongside PNG. 26 new tests, 3553 total.
stories.description: Add JPEG detection and decoding alongside PNG. Detect JPEG by signature (0xFF 0xD8). For decode, use pure Julia baseline JPEG decoder (8-bit, no progressive) or fall back to text representation. Add :image_jpeg output_type or reuse :image_png with generic :image type.
acceptanceCriteria: JPEG bytes decoded to pixel matrix
OutputWidget renders JPEG via same PixelImage path

stories.title: SVG text fallback rendering
stories.description: For image/svg+xml output, render a text-based representation. Parse basic SVG elements (rect, circle, text, path) and show a simplified ASCII/Unicode rendering or just show the SVG source with syntax highlighting. No rasterization needed.
acceptanceCriteria: SVG source displayed with basic formatting

stories.title: Image interaction mode
stories.description: Add an image interaction mode triggered by a keybinding (e.g., Enter on focused image output). In this mode: arrow keys pan, +/- zoom, q exits. Maintain a viewport transform (offset_x, offset_y, zoom) that affects PixelImage rendering.
